svg.title: TwoPoints minimax geometry with classic nominal trajectory
svg.desc: Two player phase-plane plots show exact forward sets, finite backward-winning states, intersections, stagewise outer approximations and minimax trajectories. A classic nominal trajectory with fixed opponent input is overlaid.
svg.text: Exact finite-game geometry and stagewise 4D outer boxes, zonotopes, parallelotopes and ellipsoids in each player's phase plane
